newsitem.title: iran: Quakes hit Iranian cities, no casualty reports yet.
newsitem.headline: Quakes hit Iranian cities, no casualty reports yet.

text.p: Two earthquakes jolted cities in north and northwestern Iran on Wednesday, one measuring 4.8 on the Richter scale hit Ardabil and the other measuring 4.6 struck Astara, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said.

It said there were no reports yet on possible casualties or damage in Ardabil, in northwestern Iran, and Astara in the north. Earthquakes of force four or more are powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area.
IRNA said both quakes struck at 09.34 a.m. (0504 GMT).
Earthquakes often hit Iran. Earlier this month a force 7.1 quake devastated nearly 170 villages in the east of the country, killing at least 1,568 people and displacing 50,000.

A force 4.8 quake had hit Ardabil earlier this month, but did not cause damage or casualties. Many tremors with magnitudes of more than four have hit Ardabil since February 28 when an earthquake with an intensity of 5.5 struck, killing about 1,000 and injuring at least 2,600.
